Package com.spyj.format

Class ExportCommand

java.lang.Object
com.spyj.format.ExportCommand
All Implemented Interfaces:
Command
public class ExportCommand extends Object implements Command
Formats telemetry data and saves it to a report file. Acts as a concrete command in the Command pattern.

Caitlyn Maharaj

  • Constructor Details

    • ExportCommand

      public ExportCommand(LogFormatter formatter, List<TelemetryEvent> events, Map<String,Object> summary, Path output)
      Creates a command containing the information needed for one export. Copies the event list and summary map, but not their nested objects.
      Parameters:
      formatter - the strategy used to format the report
      events - the recorded telemetry events
      summary - the session information and statistics
      output - the destination file path
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any argument is null

  • Method Details

    • execute

      public void execute() throws IOException
      Generates the report and writes it to the destination file. Creates missing parent directories and replaces existing file content.
      Specified by:
      execute in interface Command
      Throws:
      IOException - if report generation, directory creation, or file writing fails
